title: State v. Boone
facts: A warehouse owned by the defendant's competitor burned down overnight
No direct witness placed the defendant at the scene
jury_instructions: Circumstantial evidence may support a conviction, but each inference must be reasonable and consistent with guilt beyond a reasonable doubt.

evidence_items.content: Fire investigator's report identifying an accelerant consistent with gasoline.
Receipt showing the defendant purchased gasoline containers the day before the fire.
Cell tower records placing the defendant's phone near the warehouse that night.
